subject: Q3 Close — Exec cover matrix & EB micro‑sprints (finalize MAP)
body:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
Cc: procure@acme.com
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Q3 Close — Exec cover matrix & EB micro‑sprints (finalize MAP)

Team / Acme — opening thread. Quick callout: we need to lock the executive sponsor coverage and a short EB meeting cadence so the Q3 close timeline doesn't slip. Attached is ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (working draft), and an EB attendee roster PDF.

Key asks in this note:
- Acme: confirm which execs will attend the EB sessions (CEO/CPO/Head of Security) and any proxy rules.
- Redwood: Priya to own exec roster matrix; Marissa to own MAP acceptance criteria; Ben to lead technical eval scheduling; Vivek to confirm SFDC/HubSpot milestones.
- All: pick two 45‑minute EB windows next week for micro‑sprints (we'll run two focused sessions: product+integration, then security+SLA).

Proposed EB micro‑sprint windows (pick your top two):
- Wed 2027‑08‑11 16:00–16:45 PT
- Thu 2027‑08‑12 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu 2027‑08‑12 15:30–16:15 PT

Notes: the attached MAP draft has a condensed set of milestones tied to the mutual action plan. I trimmed lower‑priority asks to keep the EB sessions focused on gating items that impact go/no‑go. I'll upload the HubSpot mutual plan and DocuSign envelope after we confirm attendees.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0191

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 10:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Q3 Close — Exec cover matrix & EB micro‑sprints (finalize MAP)

All — I can cover the tech eval windows. My availability: Thu 08/12 morning preferred (09:00 PT works). I want to lock a 30‑45 minute follow up with Acme eng to run the integration checklist (I put a short list in mutual_action_plan_notes.docx).

Also can we confirm SLA questions in advance so we have a concise SLT summary for the EB session? If Marissa can pull the top 5 quality/regression metrics we should be set.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Q3 Close — Exec cover matrix & EB micro‑sprints (finalize MAP)

Thanks Priya — we prefer Thu 08/12 09:00 PT and Thu 08/12 15:30 PT (if you need two windows the 09:00 and 15:30 ones work for our execs).

Attendees (tentative):
- Nikhil Kapoor — CTO (will lead the tech Q&A)
- Priya Desai — VP Product (product fit)
- Karen Huang — Head of Security (SLA/disposition)
- Olivia Grant — Program Lead (ops contact)

Please share a short agenda (1 slide) and a one‑page risk/mitigation summary before 08/11 EOD. Procurement copied on budget milestone — we expect to receive the final MAP and T&Cs before Tue 08/17 for internal approval.

Sanjay
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Acme Enterprises

Subject: Re: Q3 Close — Exec cover matrix & EB micro‑sprints (finalize MAP)

Sanjay / Olivia — thanks, locking Thu 08/12 09:00 PT as EB sprint #1 (product+integration) and Thu 08/12 15:30 PT as EB sprint #2 (security+SLA). I've attached EB_Attendee_Roster.pdf with the expected internal attendees and the exec proxies if something shifts.

Action items for Redwood before 08/11 EOD:
- Priya: publish ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx to HubSpot and push DocuSign envelope (priority).
- Ben: finalize integration checklist and mark any items that require extended engineering time (>2 weeks).
- Vivek: update HubSpot milestones to include the two EB sessions + procurement milestone on 08/17.
- Marissa: build the one‑page risk/mitigation and a one‑slide agenda (attached to this thread).

I'll also add a short recording of the MAP changes to the Drive folder. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2027-Q3-58 — please comment on the mutual plan.

Marissa Cole

Acme + team — final locked plan below. Thank you for quick confirmations.

Locked EB micro‑sprints:
- Thu 2027‑08‑12 09:00–09:45 PT — Product & Integration (CTO Nikhil + VP Product Priya Desai)
- Thu 2027‑08‑12 15:30–16:15 PT — Security & SLA (Head of Security Karen Huang + Program Lead Olivia Grant)

MAP and milestones (high level):
- 08/11 EOD — Redwood delivers one‑page risk/mitigation and DocuSign envelope (Marissa / Priya).
- 08/12 — EB micro‑sprints (locked).
- 08/17 EOD — Acme internal procurement decision / budget sign‑off.
- 08/20 — If approved, kickoff Dedicated onboarding sprint.

Attachments in this thread: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (final working copy), EB_Attendee_Roster.pdf, mutual_action_plan_notes.docx.

Marissa has uploaded the final slide; Ben has the integration checklist items flagged in the notes. Vivek — please confirm HubSpot milestones are updated to reflect the procurement milestone on 08/17 and move the close stage to 'Commit — EB Pending'.

Sanjay / Olivia — can you confirm procurement will accept the DocuSign envelope by 08/17? If yes, we will schedule a brief check‑in 08/18 to confirm next steps.

Thanks — locking and moving to exec rollcall.

Priya Natarajan
